lines.text: The Butler draws a minim and adds a tiny dot just after it.
It adds half the note again
A minim is two beats. Half of two is one. So with the dot, it lasts three.
Clara holds the note and counts: one, two, three. The dot was the three.
Then the clock strikes four, and Clara is still holding her next note. She pressed it only once.
is a semibreve. One note for the whole bar.
A true story from music history.
Semibreve means half a breve, and breve means short. Once upon a time, the breve really was a short note.
Like the minim, it grew longer over the years. Today the breve is so long you’ll hardly ever see it.
A dot adds half again. A semibreve fills the whole bar.
